#### The digit-average rule on new images

The course overview's [digit-average rule](course-overview.qmd#sol-two-features-ten-digits)
labels an image with the digit whose average (center ink, left ink) is nearest,
and it was scored on the same images the averages came from.
Split the 1,797 images at random into two halves,
a [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set)
and a [test set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-test-set).
Compute the digit averages from the training set only.
What share of each set does the rule get right?

:::
